_comment: Copy to ~/.config/cc-portable-bootstrap/profile.json and edit. Mode 600.
This file holds machine-specific topology and must never be committed.
runsLocalProxy: does this host run its own cliproxyapi instance?
servesOthers:   does this host serve other machines (hub)? Only the hub sets true.
endpoints:      candidates, tried in ascending priority order.
HTTP is allowed only for strict loopback; anything else must be HTTPS.
A tunnelled hub is still loopback here, because the tunnel maps it
to a local port.
tunnel:         optional. Only set it when the endpoint needs an SSH tunnel opened
first. host is an ssh config alias.
remoteDev:      optional. Omit it entirely on a machine that never opens a remote
workspace; rdev then reports that no host is configured.
transport:      auto (Mux when a build is usable, otherwise SSH) | mux | ssh.
hosts[].name:   short local name you type, e.g. `rdev --host <name>`.
hosts[].sshAlias:      an ssh config alias; rdev never learns an address or port.
hosts[].defaultWorkspace: workspace opened when no name is given. Default "dev".
hosts[].multiplexer:   SSH-fallback session keeper: auto | tmux | zellij | none.
zellij cannot carry a workspace command, so agent shortcuts
such as rclaude need auto, tmux or none.
hosts[].remotePath:    absolute or ~/ directories prepended to PATH on the remote.
